current_grouping: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction
canonical_title: Electrical bonding and protection against lightning and static electricity

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.title_at_revision: Electrical bonding and protection against lightning and static electricity
versions.text: See AMC.867 (a) (a) The UAV must be protected against catastrophic effects from lightning and static electricity. A lightning analysis assessment has to be carried out and agreed with the Certifying Authority. (b) For metallic components, compliance with sub-paragraph (a) may be shown by (1) Bonding the components and grounding them properly to the airframe; or (2) Designing the components so that a strike will not result in a catastrophic event. (c) For non-metallic components, compliance with sub-paragraph (a) may be shown by (1) Designing the components to minimise the effect of a strike; or (2) Incorporating acceptable means of diverting the resulting electrical current so as not to result in a Catastrophic event.
